name: cliplab
description: A character studio for procedural SVG avatars: build a body, layer the eyes, sequence animations, and export a lightweight embeddable clip.
author: Tonio

scripts.size: vite build --ssr tools/size/bake.ts --outDir dist-size/bin --logLevel warn && node dist-size/bin/bake.js && node tools/size/runtime-sizes.mjs
scripts.board: vite build --ssr tools/board.ts --outDir dist-size/bin --logLevel warn && node dist-size/bin/board.js
scripts.clearance: vite build --ssr tools/clearance.ts --outDir dist-size/bin --logLevel warn && node dist-size/bin/clearance.js
scripts.og: vite build --ssr tools/og.ts --outDir dist-size/bin --logLevel warn && node dist-size/bin/og.js
scripts.favicon: vite build --ssr tools/favicon.ts --outDir dist-size/bin --logLevel warn && node dist-size/bin/favicon.js
